# Neural_Dynamical_Systems

**Domain**: iNEST

## Definition
A class of recurrent neural networks whose state evolution is governed by differential equations, modeling continuous-time dynamics for prediction tasks. Provides a principled framework for real-time forecasting that aligns with neuromorphic hardware's analog, time-continuous operation.
